AhroVista (1.5%) | chrtitle = General Director | chairman = Ivan Kuzmenko | manager = [[Volodymyr Sharan]] | league = [[Ukrainian First League]] | season = [[2025–26 Ukrainian Premier League|2025–26]] | position = Ukrainian Premier League, 15th of 16 (relegated via play-offs) | current = 2025–26 FC Oleksandriya season | website = {{url|https://fco.com.ua/}} | pattern_la1 = | pattern_b1 = _oleksandriya2526h | pattern_ra1 = | pattern_sh1 = | pattern_so1 = | leftarm1 = FFFF00 | body1 = FFFF00 | rightarm1 = FFFF00 | shorts1 = 000000 | socks1 = FFFF00 | pattern_la2 = _nikechallenge5bw | pattern_b2 = _nikechallenge5bw | pattern_ra2 = _nikechallenge5bw | pattern_sh2 = | pattern_so2 = | leftarm2 = 000000 | body2 = 000000 | rightarm2 = 000000 | shorts2 = 000000 | socks2 = 000000 | pattern_la3 = | pattern_b3 = | pattern_ra3 = | pattern_sh3 = | pattern_so3 = | leftarm3 = | body3 = | rightarm3 = | shorts3 = | socks3 = }} '''Football Club Oleksandriya''' ({{langx|uk|Футбольний клуб Олександрія}}), commonly known as '''Oleksandriya''', is a Ukrainian professional [[Association football|football]] [[Club (organization)|club]] based in the city of [[Oleksandriya]], [[Kirovohrad Oblast]]. Founded in 1990, the club plays in the [[Ukrainian First League]] in 2026-27 following relegation from the [[Ukrainian Premier League]]. The year 1948 on the club's crest appeared after its merger with UkrAhroKom in 2014 and depicts football heritage of the club rather than the club's foundation. In 2014 the club changed ownership when the original owner [[Mykola Lavrenko]] sold it to [[Serhiy Kuzmenko]], the owner of UkrAhroKom. Debuting in the [[2016–17 UEFA Europa League]] in July 2016, the club became the first one from [[Kirovohrad Oblast]] to qualify for the European competitions and second after [[FC Kryvbas Kryvyi Rih (1959–2013)|Kryvbas]] in [[Central Ukraine]] ([[Right-bank Ukraine|Right-bank]])."}}
